about: The approved words of release A (release 103), row by row: 110 rows of the word table CHANGES-A.tsv, 108 with new words and 2 removed. Row 889 and the new words of rows 380, 1177, 1204, 1206 and 1209 come from the fix round after the review (2026-11-11). The new words of rows 1205 and 1211 come from release 104 (2026-11-12). Made by a script from that table; not edited by hand. Read by server/test/words-a.test.js. Release 106 (redesign step E, 2026-11-16), by a script again: the new words of row 889 no longer name a phone number, and row 936 is taken out because its screen, the contact card, is gone; 109 rows are left.
row: the row of the word table. line: its line in app/ui.js before the release (commit 0a82d9f), for the reader only. fn: the top-level unit of app/ui.js the sentence stands in.
Signs (apostrophe, three dots, curly quotes) are written here in the form the file writes them in that string: the sign itself, or backslash, u and four digits.

kind words: old and new are the sentence cut at its values. Word pieces stand at the even places, the values (code) at the odd ones. The test looks for the pieces in order, each value between its two pieces and joined to them by + or ${ }, the first piece opening a string and the last one closing it: new must stand in the unit fn, old nowhere in the file.

kind cases: a sentence the code puts together from pieces with a choice in it. code is the expression as the file writes it; it must stand in the unit fn, and run with args it must give the sentence gives. A list roles in args answers the reads of p.role in turn, so that powerLead gives each pair of words of the table (three of the six pairs no account sees, because one answer chooses both words). gone: pieces of the old code that stand nowhere in the file.

kind markup: as cases, for a string of HTML. Run with args the code must have the tags (the tags of the old string, in order), hold none of < > & " ' ` outside them, and read gives once each tag is a space.
kind removed: the two strings of gone stand nowhere in the file, and last (the entry before them and what follows the list) stands in the unit fn.

replaced: what the first build of release A said in five rows and the fix round replaced. was: those words, as the sign itself and escaped where they hold a sign. None of them may stand anywhere in the file.
